name: Absorption-Only Radiography via Unsorted Hexahedron Projection
definition: A hardware-accelerated technique to simulate radiographs in the absorption-only regime (emissivity J=0) for curvilinear hexahedral meshes, avoiding the need for a global back-to-front visibility sort by accumulating optical thickness additively.
summary: Absorption-Only Radiography via Unsorted Hexahedron Projection simulates X-ray images by additively accumulating optical thickness, eliminating the need for global sorting and supporting direct hexahedral projection.
